entries.en: It's not meant to be taken literally...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still, if you're comin' up with a good[n]name... Well, whatever. Let's check it out!

entries.en: Ha, you're such a child. Try not to[n]embarrass the rest of us, would you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, what's the plan? You wanna head[n]inside?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sure thing. We know where the place is[n]now, so we can wander around a bit.
